summary: This is a careful, preregistered paired study that tested whether inserting a deterministic network verifier reduces undetected emulator-executed faults for LLM→config outputs under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Execution and analysis are consistent with the preregistration: 72 confirmatory pairs, a single shared initial LLM generation per intent (gpt-5-mini), deterministic verifier runs, and a completed paired analysis that found no baseline faults (n_11=72), producing a degenerate paired difference of 0.0 (95% CI 0.0–0.0, exact McNemar p=1.0). The manuscript appropriately frames this as a ceiling/null outcome and documents limitations (shared_initial_candidate design, single model, emulated tasks, sampling-parameter uncertainty). Artifacts, manifests, and hashes are provided and appear complete.
